title: Cyprus Seniors Provincial competition
text:
Cyprus Seniors Provincial competition is a competition for any Cyprus student attending at any public or private high-school (Lyceum). Until 2003 there was no Provincial competition for 1st grade students. There was only Seniors Pancyprian Competition. As of 2004 Four Provincial competitions are held for every grade (1st, 2nd, 3rd) in November, one in every district capital. In Lefkosia is called "Iakovos Patatsos", in Lemesos is called "Andreas Vlamis", in Larnaka and Ammochostos is called "Petrakis Kyprianou" and in Pafos is called "Andreas Hadjitheoris". All districts have the same paper for each grade, but each grade has a different paper.

Afterwards 10 high-school (Lyceum) students from every grade (1st, 2nd and 3rd grade) of the from every district are selected.

Total: 4 districts * 3 grades * 10 students = 120 students.
